title: Deterministic bounded parameter sweeps
objective: Implement a deterministic, resource-bounded, cancellation-aware parameter-sweep contract with structured per-item outcomes and portable sequential fallback

handoff.summary: Implemented an ordinary-Python deterministic bounded parameter-sweep contract with zero-callback planning, stable input ordering, reproducible 52-bit per-item seeds and shard offsets, fixed aggregate evaluation/memory/trace/result credits, measured input/result JSON, cooperative deadlines and cancellation, collect/fail-fast policies, bounded synchronous batch-executor backpressure, explicit sequential fallback, structured per-item outcomes, finite detached JSON, and reproducibility provenance. Focused CPython and Sage.js tests cover ODE-shaped use, adversarial failure/budget behavior, reversed completion order, and a real CPython threaded adapter whose active work never exceeds the requested bound.
risks: Memory accounting and synchronous callback cancellation are necessarily cooperative; a host needing preemption must enforce it at its worker boundary.
Equal deterministic credit partitioning is conservative for heterogeneous jobs; unused item credits are intentionally not timing-dependently reassigned.

The recorded 256-item trivial-callback benchmark measured 23 microseconds/item in CPython and 1.31 milliseconds/item in Sage.js; canonical result serialization measured 33.5 microseconds/item and 4.98 milliseconds/item respectively. Real solver work amortizes this, but tiny jobs should be grouped and serialization remains a visible runtime cost.
Only CPython Linux x64, Sage.js/Node Linux x64, and a CPython threaded adapter have focused receipts in this lane; no browser-worker or release-platform support is claimed yet.
Repository-wide test:changed is blocked before this lane by the integration branch's currently unowned numerical approximation package in architecture/package-graph.json.
next_steps: Integration must add src/lib/sagejs/numerics/sweeps.py to architecture/package-graph.json and pyrightconfig.json, then re-export the public API from sagejs.numerics and classify it in the numerical capability/surface ledgers.

Integration should retain test/numerics/sweeps/bounded-sweeps.cjs in the numerical test discovery and rerun complete numerics, architecture, and strict-Python gates after all domain package ownership is registered.
Add a thin public ODE adapter that charges the nested OdeResult evaluation count and returns its structured result; do not implement a second scheduler in the ODE package.
Qualify the integrated source and any replayable browser worker adapter on Linux ARM64, macOS ARM64, Windows x64, browser, SEA, and npm before publishing those capability claims.
